import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["payments"].copy()

    amount_null = df["amount"].isna()
    amount_nonpos = (~amount_null) & (df["amount"] <= 0)

    valid_currencies = ["USD", "EUR", "GBP"]
    currency_bad = (~df["currency"].isin(valid_currencies)) | df["currency"].isna()
    currency_invalid = (~amount_null) & (~amount_nonpos) & currency_bad

    country_null = (~amount_null) & (~amount_nonpos) & (~currency_invalid) & df["country"].isna()

    reject_mask = amount_null | amount_nonpos | currency_invalid | country_null

    reason_code = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype="object")
    reason_code = reason_code.mask(amount_null, "AMT_NULL")
    reason_code = reason_code.mask((~amount_null) & amount_nonpos, "AMT_NONPOS")
    reason_code = reason_code.mask((~amount_null) & (~amount_nonpos) & currency_invalid, "CCY_INVALID")
    reason_code = reason_code.mask(
        (~amount_null) & (~amount_nonpos) & (~currency_invalid) & country_null,
        "CTRY_NULL"
    )

    clean_df = df.loc[~reject_mask].copy()
    clean_df["amount"] = clean_df["amount"].round(2)

    rejects_df = df.loc[reject_mask].copy()
    rejects_df["reason_code"] = reason_code.loc[reject_mask]

    clean_df = clean_df.reset_index(drop=True)
    rejects_df = rejects_df.reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "payments_clean": clean_df,
        "payments_rejects": rejects_df,
    }
